note.zh: 在 omp 中以 Qwen 3.6 27B 一次生成，未修改。基于 Three.js 的体素世界：柏林噪声区块地形、三种生物群系（平原/沙漠/雪原）、第一人称 WASD 控制与鼠标环视、8 种可放置方块、左键破坏右键放置、粒子效果，内置神话建筑（神秘高塔、冰晶神庙、远古遗迹、魔法石阵、水晶地穴）。
note.en: One-shot by Qwen 3.6 27B in omp harness, unmodified. A Three.js voxel world: Perlin noise chunked terrain with 3 biomes (plains/desert/snow), first-person WASD + mouse look, 8 placeable block types, left-click break / right-click place, particle effects, with mythological structures (mystical tower, ice temple, ancient ruins, mystic circle, crystal cave).
